## Discovery & Translational Science

- **Activation of perivascular thermogenic fat mitigates aortic stenosis** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.13.758767)
  - Pharmacological activation of perivascular adipose tissue (PVAT) using a β₃-adrenergic agonist or physiological cold exposure reduced aortic stenosis (AS) progression and promoted aortic wall remodeling in mouse models, an effect abolished in PVAT-deficient mice.
  - Human ¹⁸F-FDG PET-CT imaging revealed that mediastinal thermogenic fat activity correlates inversely with AS severity parameters, indicating PVAT-dependent remodeling as a therapeutic target for AS.

- **GWAS identifies *CLIC1* and *ANXA11* as genetic drivers of sarcoidosis chronicity** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.12.29.24319750)
  - A meta-analysis of Swedish (1,515 cases) and German (1,216 cases) cohorts identified distinct genetic variants associated with sarcoidosis disease trajectory, including rs1049550 (OR = 0.68) in non-Löfgren chronic cases.
  - Gene-based analysis linked *CLIC1* to non-chronic sarcoidosis and *ANXA11* to chronic disease, with pathway analysis highlighting antigen presentation as a central mechanism driving chronicity.

- **`[Big Pharma]` Regeneron siRNA candidate targeting CIDEB reduces liver fat** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Single-dose siRNA targeting *CIDEB* demonstrated significant liver fat reduction without accompanying weight loss in preclinical findings highlighted by `@DrSamuelBHume`.

- **Mitophagy inducers identified for Alzheimer's disease via endogenous ATP5B tagging** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033909/)
  - High-throughput screening using an endogenous ATP5B tagging reporter platform identified novel small-molecule mitophagy inducers for evaluation in Alzheimer's disease models.

- **PIAS1 suppresses vascular calcification via VDAC1-NLRX1 axis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033884/)
  - PIAS1 attenuated vascular calcification in diabetic preclinical models by suppressing mitochondrial DNA leakage mediated through the VDAC1-NLRX1 signaling pathway.

- **LncRNA MELTF-AS1 drives colorectal cancer via miR-139-5p/NOTCH1 axis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033319/)
  - Mechanistic study identified lncRNA MELTF-AS1 as a competitive endogenous RNA promoting colorectal cancer progression through sequestration of miR-139-5p and upregulation of NOTCH1.

## Early Trials — Phase I–II

- **`[Biotech]` Zura Bio's tibulizumab fails Phase 2 trial in hidradenitis suppurativa** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Dual IL-17A/IL-17F and TNF-α targeting bispecific antibody tibulizumab missed its primary efficacy endpoint in a Phase 2 trial for hidradenitis suppurativa, per `@adamfeuerstein`.

- **`[Big Pharma]` Lilly's Taltz combined with tirzepatide improves ACR50 in psoriatic arthritis** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Combining Taltz (ixekizumab) with GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist tirzepatide yielded higher ACR50 response rates in patients with psoriatic arthritis, per `@bioinvestor24`.

- **`[Biotech]` Viking Therapeutics Phase 1 VK3019 trial completion near** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - The single-dose Phase 1 trial evaluating VK3019 is projected to complete before year-end, per `@semodough`.

- **Phase 1 trial outlines pharmacokinetic profile of four-drug regimen in *M. abscessus*** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033361/)
  - A Phase 1 clinical trial characterized drug-drug interactions and pharmacokinetic parameters for a novel four-drug combination targeting *Mycobacterium abscessus* complex infections.

## Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

- **`[Biotech]` Sellas Life Sciences prepares for Phase 3 REGAL AML readout** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Topline efficacy and safety data from the pivotal Phase 3 REGAL study of galinpepimut-S (GPS) in acute myeloid leukemia are expected later this month, per `@Maximus_Holla`.

- **Carboplatin addition improves overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033282/)
  - An updated systematic review and meta-analysis confirmed that adding carboplatin to standard anthracycline-taxane neoadjuvant/adjuvant chemotherapy provides a definitive overall survival benefit in triple-negative breast cancer.

- **Real-world safety analysis compares zanubrutinib and ibrutinib in CLL** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43034813/)
  - Evaluated the incidence of treatment-emergent atrial fibrillation in chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients receiving second-generation BTK inhibitor zanubrutinib compared against a historical ibrutinib control cohort.

## Regulatory & Approvals

- **`[Biotech]` FDA issues CRL for Summit Therapeutics' ivonescimab in NSCLC** [X/@JacobPlieth](https://x.com/JacobPlieth/status/2121953513068450071)
  - FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for the BLA seeking approval of ivonescimab (PD-1/VEGF bispecific) plus chemotherapy in post-TKI EGFR-mutated non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer based on the HARMONI trial.
  - FDA stated that substantial evidence of effectiveness was not established, concluding that a progression-free survival benefit without a statistically significant overall survival benefit fails to support a positive benefit-risk profile.

- **`[Biotech]` GRAIL targets early 2027 FDA decision for Galleri test** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - FDA regulatory decision for the Galleri multi-cancer early detection panel is anticipated by early 2027, with targeted reimbursement set at $500–$600, per `@BioStocks`.

## Business & Strategy

- **`[Biotech]` Lineage Cell Therapeutics acquires NeuroAirmid for $4.7M** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Lineage Cell Therapeutics acquired NeuroAirmid in a $4.7 million transaction, expanding its neurodegenerative pipeline with an early-stage Huntington’s disease cell therapy asset, per `@yaireinhorn`.

- **`[Biotech]` Menin inhibitor launch dynamics focus on Syndax and Kura Oncology** [X/@BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2121554826932748750)
  - Strategic analysis weighs Syndax’s first-mover advantage against Kura Oncology’s potential tolerability differentiation in the commercial rollout of menin inhibitors for acute leukemias, per `@Andre_AGTC`.

## Public Health & Policy

- **Global analysis links climate variability to child respiratory mortality** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.31.26361864)
  - Global Burden of Disease (1990–2023) data across 171 countries demonstrated a trend-level positive association between interannual temperature variability and childhood mortality from lower respiratory infections (+0.278 per 1 °C) and asthma (+0.836 per 1 °C).
  - The minimum mortality temperature for childhood lower respiratory infection was calculated at 17.1 °C globally, though sensitivity tests suggest this reflects broader geographic baseline trends rather than acute direct dose-response effects.

- **National Kidney Foundation issues IMPACT report on proteinuria measurement** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43033861/)
  - The NKF 2025 Proteinuria-Albuminuria Workshop published standardized consensus methodologies for measuring albuminuria and proteinuria across clinical practice and trial endpoints.
